calls.title: Ashley/Cris Bi-Weekly
calls.summary: The team is focusing on building a structured customer success program to support high-value clients with a transition to dedicated roles and a goal of automation to reduce manual efforts. Cris Dizon is leading improvements in feature request tracking, exploring better tooling options to streamline the process. Sales enablement efforts include training pre-sales staff and growing consulting services to meet increasing customer support demand. The discussion also covered a framework for experimentation maturity, emphasizing speeding up experiments and improving quality through self-serve execution. Plans are underway for creating a blog and podcast to share insights, with a target audience of teams beginning their experimentation journeys.
calls.keywords: Customer Success, Experimentation Maturity, Program Enablement, Consulting Services, Feature Request Management, Sales Enablement
calls.action_items:
**Cris Dizon**
Assess and experiment with Pylon, GitHub, and HubSpot tools to improve feature request tracking and customer communication processes (08:30)
Continue stepping into and managing key large customers and developing engagement cadences (05:00)
Prepare and assemble initial materials for a customer enablement consulting guide, focusing on strategic and program-building advice (13:00)
Develop or source a standard QBR deck for customer success reviews and share it within the team (15:00)
Collaborate with Scott and Elise on persona definition and organizational structure documents for GrowthBook, providing feedback from customer success perspective (28:30)
Contact Rudger from Mint Mines to explore automation and feature-building resources to enhance customer offerings (14:10)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Share her QBR deck and collaborate with Cris on drafting a blog post and podcast episode around establishing and scaling experimentation programs (26:30)
Facilitate an introductory contact between Cris and Rudger (14:15)

**Cris Dizon and Ashley Stirrup**
Create a structured outline and then record a session where Cris explains experimentation maturity lessons for content development (33:30)
